tei:div.tei:p: “baShanah haBa’ah” (Next Year) by Ehud Manor (1941-2005) was first published in 1970 as sung with music by Nurit Hirsch and performed by the duo Ilan & Ilanit (Hanna Dresner-Tzakh and Shlomo Zach). The song was written by Manor in memory of his younger brother, Yehuda Wiener (1949-1968), who was killed in a tank battle by Egyptian gunfire in the Sinai Desert during the War of Attrition. We are not certain whether the English translation appearing in David Breakstone and Cindy Jochnowitz’s The Israel Experience Book (1977), p.242, was by Manor or remains uncredited.
